content: Syncthing: continuous bidirectional multi-device sync with conflict resolution, background daemon, discovery/relay infra -- built for a harder/differently-shaped problem than a one-directional occasional pull. rsync: differential/delta transfer, resumable, designed for scheduled/triggered one-off or periodic transfers, no persistent daemon needed beyond sshd. rclone: unified interface to cloud/object-storage backends, not relevant absent a cloud target. For a two-node, one-direction, occasional-connectivity archive pull (car -> pit laptop, local network only), rsync over SSH triggered by a network-availability hook is the right-sized tool.
